name: Catalyst: Blind Faith
source:
"The year is 605, and in your home— the country of Corcaea— the souls of mankind belong to demons."

Not all hope is lost.

In an apocalyptic, early-medieval land, the Gods are real and the souls of mankind belong to demons. The phenomenon turning men into monsters is known as the Catalyst, and it triggers in individuals who cannot wrest control over their emotions.

You are a troubled young priest, who possesses the ability to channel the power of any God in your pantheon through your damaged body. It is your mission to find a cure for the weakness in mankind.

Answers lie in wait at the bottom of demon-infested ruins that cover the world, but forbidden knowledge comes at a high price.

In this action-packed rollercoaster of horror and dark fantasy adventure, your challenge is not merely to save the last of humanity. The freedom of choice is truly granted to you, thanks to a gargantuan web of choices, and 10 unique paths that allow you to pursue the relationships that you value most— but due to the mental illness and physical challenges that the protagonist faces, these choices are not always as they appear. 

You do not have to go it alone. The Gods are on your side, and a bizarre cast of monsters and men can be made into friends, enemies, and even lovers. 

Given the chance, how much would you sacrifice to follow your heart?

[From [url=https://phylactery-studios.itch.io/catalyst-blind-faith]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“时值605年，在你的故乡科尔凯亚，人类的灵魂归恶魔所有。”

但希望尚未彻底消失。

在这片濒临末日、处于中世纪早期的土地上，诸神确实存在，而人类的灵魂却属于恶魔。一种被称为“催化”的现象，会将人化作怪物。当一个人无法掌控自己的情绪时，它便会发作。

你是一名饱受困扰的年轻祭司，能够以残损的身体为媒介，借用所信奉诸神中任何一位的力量。你的使命，是找到治愈人类这一弱点的方法。

遍布世界、恶魔盘踞的遗迹深处，藏着你所寻求的答案。但禁忌的知识，往往需要付出高昂的代价。

在这场动作不断、跌宕起伏的恐怖与黑暗奇幻冒险中，你的挑战远不止拯救人类最后的幸存者。庞大的选择网络与十条独特路线，让你真正拥有选择的自由，追寻自己最珍视的关系。然而，由于主角面临精神疾病与身体上的困难，这些选择并不总像表面上那样简单。

你不必独自前行。诸神站在你这边，各种古怪的怪物与人类，也可能成为朋友、敌人，甚至恋人。

如果有机会，你愿意为追随自己的内心，牺牲多少？

[摘自[url=https://phylactery-studios.itch.io/catalyst-blind-faith]Itch.io[/url]]
